description: Retry backoff schedule planner — Plan retry delays for API clients and agents: exponential backoff with none, full, equal or decorrelated jitter (AWS definitions). Returns each retry's min/expected/max delay, elapsed time, worst-case total, whether it fits a time budget, and success odds. Params: retries (1-30, required); base ms (default 500); factor (default 2); max ms cap (default 30000); jitter=none|full|equal|decorrelated (default full); timeout per-attempt ms; budget total ms; retry_after seconds from a 429/503; p_fail 0-1 per-attempt failure probability. Offline. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_backoff
